dimensions.assessment: Affects the Government Accountability Office, the Appalachian Regional Commission, and businesses or communities within the Appalachian region relying on broadband.
dimensions.evidence: study on the capability of the Appalachian Regional Commission to include satellites in broadband projects

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a government study and report to Congress without enacting broader operational programs or mandates.
dimensions.evidence: the Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct, and submit to Congress the results thereof, a study

dimensions.assessment: Contains no federal appropriations or funding allocations, relying on existing GAO study mechanisms.
Directs a single federal agency to analyze satellite broadband capacity, economic growth, and cost-effectiveness within a specific regional commission.
dimensions.evidence: review the capacity of satellite broadband services to be used for business purposes

dimensions.assessment: Requires a one-time study and report to be submitted not later than one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this section, the Comptroller General ... shall conduct ... a study

missing_information: Costs associated with conducting the GAO study are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the Government Accountability Office to conduct a specific study and report regarding the Appalachian Regional Commission's satellite broadband capabilities.
